USG DOOPLER STUDY OF CAROTID ARTERIAL SYSTEM

[2D; COLOUR AND SPECTRAL STUDY]

 

Bilateral common carotid artery ( entire extent ) as well as proximal part of bilateral external and internal carotid arteries are scanned. In addition, bilateral vertebral arteries are scanned within foramen transversorium (as far as visualised).

 

Bilateral common carotid arteries show normal flow spectrum with normal range peak systolic velocity. Bilateral common carotid arteries show no obvious intimo-medial thickening (N<0.8 cm) as well as no obvious plaque lesion.

 

No plaque lesion noted in both carotid bulb. Flow spectrum within bilateral carotid bulb is within normal limits.

 

Bilateral proximal internal and external carotid arteries show normal flow spectrum and peak systolic velocities. No obvious plaque lesion/ luminal narrowing noted within bilateral proximal ICA or ECA.

 

Normal flow velocity and spectrum noted through both vertebral arteries. No reversal of vertebral arterial flow (steal phenomenon) is noted.

USG DOOPLER STUDY OF CAROTID ARTERIAL SYSTEM

[2D; COLOUR AND SPECTRAL STUDY]

 

 

CAROTID SYSTEM:-

Both CCA are normal in course calibre & distal branching pattern. The intimomedial thickness is uniform and normal. No obvious soft or calcified plaques are noted. The CCA, ICA, ECA are showing peak systolic & forward diastolic pattern with no sprectral reversal or drop noted. No obvious stenosis, AVF, AVM, aneurysm or thrombosis noted. 

 

VERTEBRAL SYSTEM:-

Both vertebral artery are normal in course calibre & distal branching pattern and are showing peak systolic & forward diastolic pattern with no sprectral reversal or drop noted. No obvious stenosis, AVF, AVM, aneurysm or thrombosis noted.

USG DOPPLER STUDY OF CAROTID ARTERIAL SYSTEM

[2D; Colour & Spectral Study]

===========================================================

- Bilateral common carotid artery (entire extent) as well as proximal part of bilateral external and internal carotid arteries are scanned. In addition, bilateral vertebral arteries are scanned within foramen transversorium [as far as visualised].

 

Report:

- Bilateral common carotid arteries show normal flow spectrum with normal range peak systolic velocity.  Bilateral common carotid arteries show no obvious intimo-medial thickening [N< 0.8 mm] as well as no obvious plaque lesion.

 

- No plaque lesion noted in both carotid bulb. Flow spectrum within bilateral carotid bulb is within normal limits.

 

- Bilateral proximal internal and external carotid arteries show normal flow spectrum and peak systolic velocities. No obvious plaque lesion / luminal narrowing noted within bilateral proximal ICA or ECA.

 

- Normal flow velocity and spectrum noted through both vertebral arteries.  No reversal of vertebral arterial flow [steal phenomenon] is noted.
